title: Carry immutable builder replacements through buffered property assignment
summary: Buffered properties survived replacement of the immutable builder. Creator-first, creator-last and array encodings returned the same record, including after changing only b.

change.description: When a creator property arrives after regular properties, retain each new builder returned by applying the buffered values.

notes: Both builds use the timestamped Jackson Core 3.4.0 and annotations 2.24 snapshots listed in runtime.json.
